_about: Every published firmware release and what it was built on, plus the ESP-IDF each pinned core ships (read at the source). The release gate reads the IDF of the oldest version a new release may update from (its min_from) and refuses an over-the-air release whose NVS format differs (docs/OTA.md, 'NVS format and rollback'). Add a line for each release; never edit an old one.
